articles.title: Meet Swiftiephylus, a group of insects named after Taylor Swift
articles.snippet: Four newly described species of Australian plant bug have been named in honor of world-famous pop star Taylor Swift.

articles.title: Peru’s penguins are in trouble. A super El Niño could worsen things
articles.snippet: Bird flu, overfishing and warming seas have crashed the world’s largest colony of Humboldt penguins. Scientists are working to help them bounce back.
